mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ai_care_alert(alert_key,elder_id,source_id,kind,detail,evidence_key,task_key) VALUES(#{alert.alertKey},#{alert.elderId},#{alert.sourceId},#{alert.kind},#{alert.detail},#{alert.evidenceKey},#{alert.taskKey}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE state=IF(evidence_key != VALUES(evidence_key),'OPEN',state), reviewer_id=IF(evidence_key != VALUES(evidence_key),NULL,reviewer_id), resolution_note=IF(evidence_key != VALUES(evidence_key),NULL,resolution_note), resolved_at=IF(evidence_key != VALUES(evidence_key),NULL,resolved_at), revision=IF(evidence_key != VALUES(evidence_key),revision+1,revision), kind=VALUES(kind),detail=VALUES(detail),task_key=VALUES(task_key),evidence_key=VALUES(evidence_key)
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM ai_care_alert WHERE id=#{id} FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE ai_care_alert SET resolution_note=IF(state='RESOLVED',resolution_note,'执行记录已登记为已执行，仍可查看历史'), resolved_at=IF(state='RESOLVED',resolved_at,NOW()),state='RESOLVED',evidence_key=REPEAT('0',64),revision=revision+1 WHERE alert_key=#{key} AND evidence_key != REPEAT('0',64)
